subject: Fix argument types of formatting functions (#1253)
reason: The change only corrects the argument types passed to sdscatfmt in representSlotInfo (slot ranges in CLUSTER NODES, values always 0-16383) and in valkey-cli's clusterManagerNodeInfo (a small non-negative int replica count). In both cases the values fit in the low 32 bits that were already being read, so the formatted output is byte-identical on both builds on all supported ABIs. It is a type-correctness/UB cleanup with no observable behaviour change, so no compared sequence can show a difference and no scenario is needed.
